newsitem.title: DENMARK: Becalmed Danish shares tread water up to U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Becalmed Danish shares tread water up to U.S. data.

text.p: Danish share prices closed a smidgen down in a rather inactive market on Wednesday, with dealers seeing little major action but some caution ahead of Thursday's U.S. May retail price data.
"The market is consolidating at the moment and will probably remain quiet if a bit wary up to tomorrow's U.S. figures," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed a minimal 0.11 point lower at 170.27 in overall bourse turnover of 1.211 billion crowns. The KFX June future rose 0.60 point to 170.60 with 266 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

The day's most traded paper was Danisco, with 195,000 shares changing hands to close four crowns up at 404, boosted by several buy recommendations ahead of its full year 1996/97 results due on June 25.
Profit-taking hit Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg, with the former dropping 4,000 crowns to end at 240,000 and the latter shedding 6,000 crowns to finish at 345,000.
